mapper.select:
SELECT t1.`name` `name`, COALESCE(`num`,0) `num` FROM ( SELECT distinct `name` FROM conference WHERE `STATUS` = 0 ) t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count( `conference_name` ) AS `num`, `conference_name` FROM `appointment_record` WHERE `operate` = 'APPOINTMENT'
and create_time between to_timestamp(#{startTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_timestamp(#{endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
GROUP BY `conference_name` ) t2 ON t2.`conference_name` = t1.`name`

SELECT count( 1 ) `num` FROM `appointment_record` a LEFT JOIN `conference` b ON a.`conference_name` = b.`name`
a.`operate` = 'APPOINTMENT' and b.`status`=0
and a.`create_time` between to_timestamp(#{startTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_timestamp(#{endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and a.`create_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT t1.`conferenceName`, t1.`timeInterval`, COALESCE( t2.`intervalLogCount`, 0 ) `intervalLogCount` FROM ( SELECT b.`name` `conferenceName`, b.`id`, a.`time_interval` `timeInterval`, count( a.`time_interval` ) `intervalLogCount` FROM `book_time_interval` a LEFT JOIN `conference` b ON b.`id` = a.`conference_id` GROUP BY a.`time_interval`, a.`conference_id` ) t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.`time_interval`, a.`conference_id` `conferenceId`, count( a.`time_interval` ) `intervalLogCount` FROM `book_interval_record` a LEFT JOIN `conference` b ON b.`id` = a.`conference_id` LEFT JOIN `book_room` c ON c.`id` = a.`book_id`
b.status=0 AND c.`status` <> 'CANCEL_RESERVATION'
and a.`appointment_date` between to_timestamp(#{startTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_timestamp(#{endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and a.`appointment_date` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
GROUP BY a.`time_interval`, a.`conference_id` ) t2 ON t1.`timeInterval` = t2.`time_interval` and t1.`id`=t2.`conferenceId`

select `id`, `user_name`, `user_id`, `conference_name`, `operate`, `department_name`, `time_interval`, conference_device, appointment_date, `goods_Names`, `cancel_reason`, `process_ins_id` as process_instance_id, `create_time` from `appointment_record`
TO_CHAR(`create_time`, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') like concat('%',#{param.date},'%')
`create_time` like concat('%',#{param.date},'%')
and `operate`=#{param.status}
and `conference_name` like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
order by `create_time` desc
